test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Numerical Ability (Held on: 15 Nov, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: 14 men can complete a piece of work in 6 days, while 20 women can complete the same work in 8 days. 7 men started working on the job, and after working for 3 days all of them stopped working. How many women should be put on the job to complete the remaining work, if it is to be completed in 6 days?
solution:
**Given:**

Work by 14 men in 6 days = Total work

Work by 20 women in 8 days = Total work

7 men worked for 3 days, remaining work to be done by women in 6 days.

**Formula used:**

Work = Number of workers × Days × Efficiency

Efficiency ratio of men and women:

Work by 14 men in 6 days = Work by 20 women in 8 days

⇒ 14 × 6 × Efficiency of men = 20 × 8 × Efficiency of women

⇒ Efficiency of men : Efficiency of women = 20 × 8 : 14 × 6

⇒ Efficiency of men : Efficiency of women = 160 : 84 = 80 : 42 = 40 : 21

**Calculations:**

Step 1: Total work = Work done by 14 men in 6 days

⇒ Total work = 14 × 6 × Efficiency of men = 14 × 6 × 40 = 3360 units

Step 2: Work done by 7 men in 3 days

⇒ Work done = 7 × 3 × Efficiency of men = 7 × 3 × 40 = 840 units

Step 3: Remaining work

⇒ Remaining work = Total work - Work done by 7 men = 3360 - 840 = 2520 units

Step 4: Work to be completed by women in 6 days

⇒ Required number of women × 6 × Efficiency of women = Remaining work

⇒ Required number of women × 6 × 21 = 2520

⇒ Required number of women = 2520 / (6 × 21)

⇒ Required number of women = 20

**∴ 20 women are required to complete the remaining work in 6 days.**
